svg.title: Original Genie: learn a latent action interface, then use it to generate frames
svg.metadata: Genie paper · components and inference: https://arxiv.org/html/2402.15391v1

text.tspan: Original Genie: learn a latent action interface, then use it to generate frames
Genie learns what an action means from video.
Original Genie (2024) · a video tokenizer and a separate latent action model establish two discrete vocabularies.

g.title: Genie learns what an action means from video.
g.desc: Original Genie (2024) · a video tokenizer and a separate latent action model establish two discrete vocabularies. Train the spatiotemporal video tokenizer to reconstruct clips through a discrete visual codebook. The latent action encoder sees the transition, including the next frame. Its decoder reconstructs that next frame from the past and the inferred action code. Dynamics learns masked visual-token prediction using action embeddings. The action embedding is detached: dynamics loss does not train the action model. Tokenizer training precedes joint latent-action/dynamics training; the original action vocabulary has eight codes. Action embeddings are added to dynamics representations; they are not interleaved action tokens as in IRIS.

text.tspan: Tokenizer training precedes joint latent-action/dynamics training; the original action vocabulary has eight codes. Action
embeddings are added to dynamics representations; they are not interleaved action tokens as in IRIS.
At inference, the user supplies the action code.
Original Genie · generate one frame’s tokens, decode it, then append it to history.

g.title: At inference, the user supplies the action code.
g.desc: Original Genie · generate one frame’s tokens, decode it, then append it to history. Encode the available visual history and choose a learned action code. No future frame is available to infer the action at inference. The dynamics Transformer uses the selected action embedding and past visual tokens to predict masked sites in the next frame. MaskGIT refines the frame’s token grid. Decode the completed grid and append its tokens to history before taking the next action. The latent action encoder/decoder are discarded for inference; the codebook remains. Generation is autoregressive across frames, with iterative token refinement within each frame.

text.tspan: The latent action encoder/decoder are discarded for inference; the codebook remains. Generation is autoregressive across
frames, with iterative token refinement within each frame.
